question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month_date,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS delivered_count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT 
    month_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2016 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END) AS "2016",
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2017 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END) AS "2017",
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2018 THEN delivered_count ELSE 0 END) AS "2018"
FROM monthly_counts
GROUP BY month_date
ORDER BY month_date
